  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

title: Security Engineer
description:
Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

Requests will be addressed confidentially.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Security Engineer role at LEDN .

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, offering lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. The team is committed to using digital assets to democratize access to the global economy.

The role is a full-time position focusing on security across applications, identity and access management, and confidential computing, with hands-on engineering impact on product and infrastructure security.

The Opportunity

Responsibilities center on strengthening the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform, working across JavaScript/TypeScript services, an AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB, and Kubernetes microservices. You will evolve the authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches and design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect sensitive data and cryptographic operations.

This is a hands-on role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices with engineering partners.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity with MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product on usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure session management, device trust, and account recovery approaches.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads using AWS Nitro Enclaves; integrate with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations into enclave environments and ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience.
  • Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture; deploy and operate a SIEM; support SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10+ years of proven experience in Application Security focusing on web and cloud-native apps.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, especially serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication/authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and software supply chain.
  • Strong Linux knowledge; ability to remediate vulnerabilities from pen tests.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Experience with user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • Leadership mindset, adaptability, resilience, and a collaborative, empathetic approach.
  • Experience working in remote environments and thriving in startup/tech contexts.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Demonstrate progress-mindedness, adaptability, and comfort with ambiguity in a high-growth setting.
  • Be a builder, capable of creating, iterating, and scaling security practices.
  • Influence across functions with integrity and accountability, including handling confidential information.
  • Have remote-working experience.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities at a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards, competitive PTO, and company ownership through equity.
  • Remote-work flexibility up to 180 days globally (with restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and a commitment to removing barriers to doing great work.
  • Equal opportunity employer promoting inclusivity and diversity.

Note: Ledn may request accommodation. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response or have publicly available social media reviewed. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited resumes.

description:
Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • We offer a competitive PTO package to ensure you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company through shared equity; Ledn employees are stakeholders in the future of the digital economy.

We are global and remote-first, with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Note: due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. title: Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Server - cloud-init
description:
Overview

Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Server - cloud-init at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in cloud, data science, AI, engineering and IoT initiatives. We are a remote-first company with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries. Teams meet in person a few times per year to align on strategy and execution. Canonical is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Ubuntu Server is the world’s most popular Linux distribution for cloud and bare metal. In this role you will manage the team delivering cloud-init to the world, the standard for customizing cloud instances.

Cloud-init supports various distributions and underlying platforms, offering opportunities to work with cloud providers, the cloud-init community, and distributions to update their builds and serve user needs. You will own the product, influence its evolution, and collaborate with many teams and partners to coordinate new features and integrations. You should be passionate about the future of cloud-init, open source dynamics, and the needs of large, innovative customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader who values strong teams, open source software and Ubuntu. You will build a rewarding career working with talented people at Canonical.

What you’ll do and who you are are described in the sections below.

What you'll do

  • Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Work with Product Management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu and your team
  • Effectively set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization
  • Participate in engineering processes through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners
  • Oversee the quality of the Ubuntu Server image family
  • Plan and deliver Ubuntu Server features
  • Work from home with global travel for up to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have 3+ years of experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers; experience managing distributed teams is a plus

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are changing the world for the better through building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full‑time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing‑resistant approaches. You will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures; hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • Remote‑friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can do your best work.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Ledn is global with a remote‑first environment across North America, Latin America, South Africa, and Europe.

Please note, due to high application volume, only applicants who qualify will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response, and we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, unsolicited resumes will not be accepted.

  • Experience in expatriate tax.

  • Candidates with less experience will be considered for the position of associates.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple assignments, clients and staff.
  • Strong analytical, organization and communication skills.
  • An ability to work effectively under pressure and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluent in Portuguese.

  • Education/ Graduation: Business, Law, Economy, International Relations.
  • Demonstrated business development skills and enthusiasm about contributing to the growth of the Global Mobility Services practice.

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams. Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services. Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications. Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens). Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows. Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads. Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs. Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments. Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management. Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring). Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks. Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

title: Estagiario Em Direito Tutoria Ead
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros. Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente. Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário. A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono. Missão do cargo: Apoiar a equipe de comunicação em campanhas internas, interação com os clientes, desenvolvimento de conteúdos em formatos físico e digital. Apoiar no aprimoramento de processos internos, incluindo otimização do fluxo de pedidos e logística de materiais gráficos. Responsabilidades: Auxiliar nos processos de criação de peças para intranet;
Auxiliar no processo de criação de peças para redes sociais;
Auxiliar em apresentações institucionais;
Auxiliar na criação de comunicados internos e material gráfico para impressão. Requisitos obrigatórios: Ensino superior em andamento: Jornalismo ou Publicidade e Propaganda;
Conhecimentosem Pacote adobe (photoshop, indesign, lightroom e illustrator), copywriting/redação, intranet. Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/ RJ. A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Gerente De Qualidade
description: Sobre a Axioma A Axioma é a plataforma da Coodex voltada para gestão de qualidade em ambientes industriais de alta complexidade, especialmente no setor de óleo e gás. Nascida da experiência de décadas em grandes projetos, a Axioma faz a gestão de toda a documentação de qualidade e seus respectivos workflows, trazendo eficiência, rastreabilidade e conformidade em escala. Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Qualidade com background sólido em Garantia da Qualidade na indústria de Óleo & Gás e projetos EPC que queira migrar sua expertise para o mundo de tecnologia. Sua missão Representar as necessidades do setor de Qualidade em O&G dentro da Axioma, garantindo que a plataforma resolva problemas reais da indústria. Traduzir requisitos técnicos e regulatórios em histórias de produto claras para o time de tecnologia. Atuar como ponto de contato entre clientes (operadoras, EPCistas e fornecedores) e engenheiros de software da Coodex. Priorizar o backlog do produto com base em impacto para o negócio e aderência às normas (ex: ANP, API, ASME, ISO, Petrobras Book). Contribuir com visão de processos de Data Book, auditoria, inspeção e QA/QC, trazendo sua vivência prática para a evolução do produto. Participar de validações e homologações junto a clientes estratégicos. O que você precisa ter Experiência prévia (mínimo 5 anos) em Qualidade, QA/QC ou Documentação Técnica no setor de Oil&Gas, energia ou EPC. Conhecimento prático de auditorias, normas técnicas e processos de fabricação/montagem. Habilidade em traduzir necessidades técnicas da indústria em requisitos objetivos de sistema. Boa comunicação e capacidade de dialogar tanto com engenheiros de qualidade quanto com desenvolvedores de software. Visão crítica para identificar inconsistências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de documentação. Inglês intermediário/avançado (desejável para contato com multinacionais). O que oferecemos Participar da evolução de uma plataforma pioneira em Oil&Gas, premiada e já utilizada em projetos de referência. Ambiente dinâmico, com engenheiros e especialistas que unem tecnologia e indústria. Oportunidade de crescer junto com um produto global, influenciando diretamente seu roadmap. Pacote competitivo alinhado ao mercado de tecnologia e energia.

title: Banco De Talentos - Oportunidades Odebrecht Angola
description:
Olá, nós somos a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção. Fazemos parte do Grupo Novonor e atuamos, principalmente, no Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Temos mais de 80 anos de história, destes, 40 anos atuando em Angola, e nosso propósito é contribuir para a construção de um futuro sustentável, servindo à sociedade por meio da capacidade transformadora de nossa engenharia, acreditando e desenvolvendo profissionais locais para a realização do sonho dos nossos clientes. Todos os dias, nos diversos países que atuamos, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento. Ao longo dos quase 40 anos de atuação em Angola, a Odebrecht cria e implementa programas que enriquecem as comunidades, apostando fortemente na criação de emprego, na formação de cidadãos angolanos e no desenvolvimento econômico e social do país. Banco de Talentos - Oportunidades Odebrecht Angola: Este banco de talentos foi idealizado para a identificação de profissionais com expertise em operação e manutenção onshore e offshore que residam no Brasil e possuam disponibilidade e mobilidade imediata para atuação 100% presencial na região de Barra do Dande (Angola). A Odebrecht Angola está crescendo e ficaremos felizes em contar com sua a candidatura, considerando estas posições: Gerente de Operação e Manutenção;
Coordenador/ade Operações e Controle Onshore;
Coordenador/ade Operações e Controle Offshore;
Coordenador/ade Manutenção;
Supervisor/a de Plataforma de Carregamentos;
Supervisor/a de Transferência de Produtos;
Supervisor/a de Cargae Descarga de Navios;
Supervisor/a de Eletromecânica. Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. A inscrição neste banco de talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da avaliação de currículos e requisitos de cada uma das oportunidades. Quem pode se candidatar? Para as posições de nível gerencial e de coordenação, exigimos: Formação superior completa nas áreas de Engenharia Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou demais áreas correlatas;
Especialização e / ouMBA nas respectivas formações ou áreas de atuação serão um diferencial;
Experiência profissional pregressa nos cargos listados;
Disponibilidade e mobilidade imediata para atuação 100% presencial na região de Barra do Dande (Angola). Para as posições de supervisão, exigimos: Formação técnica completa nas áreas de Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou demais áreas correlatas;
Cursos e / oucertificações nas respectivas áreas de atuação são desejáveis;
Experiência profissional pregressa nos cargos listados;
Disponibilidade e mobilidade imediata para atuação 100% presencial na região de Barra do Dande (Angola). Experiência Odebrecht Angola: Aqui, valorizamos o convívio entre as gerações, integrando jovens e profissionais maduros, bem como na diversidade cultural. Acreditamos que o aprendizado acontece de múltiplas formas, oferecendo a nossos Integrantes a oportunidade de participar de programas de Trainees, Formação de Líderes, Mentoria para Mulheres, workshops técnicos e muito mais.

title: Pessoa Especialista De Responsabilidade Social
description:
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG, a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios. Missão Atuar na gestão de projetos sociais nas comunidades de influência da ENGIE, com foco nas áreas de interface dos ativos de gás natural. Garantir alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas, aos requisitos legais e aos compromissos socioambientais. Conduzir a análise, avaliação e acompanhamento de iniciativas sociais, principalmente as vinculadas a incentivos fiscais, além de consolidar e reportar informações para relatórios de sustentabilidade. Principais Responsabilidades Identificar e avaliar projetos sociais em comunidades nas áreas de atuação da ENGIE, priorizando as interfaces com os ativos de gás;
Identificar, estruturar, implementar e acompanhar a execução projetos de aporte por incentivo fiscal e iniciativas de aporte direto, assegurando aderência às diretrizes, políticas internas e legislação vigente;
Atuar em interface direta com as áreas de Relações com Públicos de Interesse (RPI) e Meio Ambiente, especialmente nas comunicações relacionadas aos licenciamentos ambientais;
Conduzir e acompanhartodo o ciclo de projetos incentivados (nos seus diversos mecanismos), incluindo inscrição, análise pela comissão, due diligence, aporte junto à controladoria e prestação de contas;
Elaborar e reportar informações relacionadas a investimentos e resultados sociais para o relatório de sustentabilidade da empresa;
Monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho social, promovendo melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a imagem institucional;
Estabelecer relacionamento com stakeholders locais, órgãos públicos, associações e entidades proponentes, assegurando transparência e legitimidade no processo. Requisitos Formação superior (áreas desejáveis: Ciências Sociais, Serviço Social ou Engenharia Ambiental);
Experiência/Vivência com projetos sociais e legislação de incentivos fiscais;
Conhecimento em due diligence e prestação de contas de projetos sociais;
Gestão de equipes matriciais;
Habilidade emgestão de indicadores e reporte de resultados sociais;
Desejável Experiênciacom relatórios de sustentabilidade e conhecimento de indicadores sociais. Local de Trabalho Rio de Janeiro/ RJ

uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente! Nosso Jeito:  Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.  Valores e Propósito:  Nosso propósito é  resolver a vida das pessoas  , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.  Diversidade e inclusão:  A Americanas S. A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. title: Pessoa especialista de responsabilidade social
description: A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG, a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.   Missão  Atuar na gestão de projetos sociais nas comunidades de influência da ENGIE, com foco nas áreas de interface dos ativos de gás natural. Garantir alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas, aos requisitos legais e aos compromissos socioambientais. Conduzir a análise, avaliação e acompanhamento de iniciativas sociais, principalmente as vinculadas a incentivos fiscais, além de consolidar e reportar informações para relatórios de sustentabilidade.  Principais Responsabilidades  Identificar e avaliar projetos sociais em comunidades nas áreas de atuação da ENGIE, priorizando as interfaces com os ativos de gás;  Identificar, estruturar, implementar e acompanhar a execução projetos de aporte por incentivo fiscal e iniciativas de aporte direto, assegurando aderência às diretrizes, políticas internas e legislação vigente;  Atuar em interface direta com as áreas de Relações com Públicos de Interesse (RPI) e Meio Ambiente, especialmente nas comunicações relacionadas aos licenciamentos ambientais;  Conduzir e acompanhar todo o ciclo de projetos incentivados (nos seus diversos mecanismos), incluindo inscrição, análise pela comissão, due diligence, aporte junto à controladoria e prestação de contas;  Elaborar e reportar informações relacionadas a investimentos e resultados sociais para o relatório de sustentabilidade da empresa;  Monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho social, promovendo melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a imagem institucional;  Estabelecer relacionamento com stakeholders locais, órgãos públicos, associações e entidades proponentes, assegurando transparência e legitimidade no processo.  Requisitos  Formação superior (áreas desejáveis: Ciências Sociais, Serviço Social ou Engenharia Ambiental);  Experiência/Vivência com projetos sociais e legislação de incentivos fiscais;  Conhecimento em due diligence e prestação de contas de projetos sociais;  Gestão de equipes matriciais;  Habilidade em gestão de indicadores e reporte de resultados sociais;  Desejável Experiência com relatórios de sustentabilidade e conhecimento de indicadores sociais. title: Project engineer
description: Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage (ENGLISH SPEAKERS) Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance  Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in  substations (up to 500k V) and  energy transmission projects  across global markets.  We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.  Key Responsibilities:  Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69k V to 500k V) Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC) Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams  Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT) Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs) Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams  Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility  What We’re Looking For:  Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field  Minimum 4+ years of experience  in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230k V to 500k V) Proficiency with Auto CAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus) Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems  Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors  Experience with software like CYMCAP, Dia LUX, PVsyst (nice to have) Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments  English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus  Bonus:  Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems) Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination  Understanding of ESG practices in engineering  Why Join Us:  Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems  Get involved in international projects with real impact  Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company  Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture  Who is Xelvin? Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.  Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more! As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.  What do we offer? Contract wise: · 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment). · 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin. · Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May. · Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly. · Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home. · Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience) Onboarding & benefits: · Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms. · A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. · You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house. · Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange. · New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip. · A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;  o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.  o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food. title: Lead technical consultant
description: Company Overview  At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.  Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.  Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together! About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant  Key Responsibilities:  Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.  Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team  Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.  Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.  In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.  Command and control during High Priority Events.  Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.  Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.  Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.  Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.  Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.  Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration) Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on Service Now ticketing tool.  Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.  Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.  Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.  Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.  A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.  Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.  Technical Skills:  Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.  Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.  Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).  Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.  Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.  Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (v Sphere and v Center) would be advantageous  Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.  Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols  Good understanding of network transfer protocols  FTP.  Proven SQL scripting skills.  Strong in automation and process improvement.  Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.  Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.  Awareness of STB software and hardware.  Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.  Good to have knowledge of Media products.  Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4 K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming  Team handling experience would be a Plus.  Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:  Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.  Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.  Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities  Quick learner  Proactive  Customer focused  Experience dealing with global customers.  Ability to work individually or as part of a team  Strong communicator at management and technical levels  Self-motivated and self-sufficient  Growth Opportunities  When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, Skill Soft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.  Benefits and Perks  Flexible working arrangements.  Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.  Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.  Equal opportunity employment.  Health and wellbeing programmes.  Collaborative work with a truly global team.  A Culture of Belonging  Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.  In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.  More information  If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOS  Fundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOS  é fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos. title: Desenvolvedor de integração
description: Estamos em busca de um  Desenvolvedor de Integração  que irá atuar como responsável técnico pela camada de integração entre os sistemas SAP (ERP S/4 HANA e IS-U HANA) e os sistemas legados da Light, aplicando práticas de Dev Sec Ops para garantir entregas seguras, escaláveis, automatizadas e de alta disponibilidade. O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.  Seus desafios serão:  Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.  Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.  Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, Rabbit MQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.  Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.  Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.  Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.  Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.  Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.  O que é necessário você ter:  Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.  Experiência com ferramentas e práticas Dev Sec Ops aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.  Domínio de CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI, Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, etc.).  Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e Web Services.  Experiência com integração segura ( JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).  Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, Open Shift).  Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, etc.).  Automação de testes e validações em integrações.  Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).  Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).  Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).  Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

title: Regional sales manager
description: Our Mission  At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:  Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Who We Are  We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.  You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.  Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.  Your Impact  As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer  Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors  Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments  Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks  Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory  Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account  Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services  Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting  Qualifications  Your Experience  Experience and knowledge of Saa S-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context  Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers  Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts  Deep knowledge of the (U. S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies) Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions  Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction  Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals  Additional Information  The Team  Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.  As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.  Our Commitment  We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação: -Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelos estatísticos para previsão de inadimplência, desenvolvimento de modelos com técnicas estatísticas tradicionais e machine learning. -Experiência com manipulação de grandes bases de dados e criação de dashboards/acompanhamento de KPIs. -Conhecimento avançado de linguagem SQL, Big query, SAS ou similar, Power Bi, pacote Office. -Desejável conhecimento na área de crédito e fraude, modelagem e estruturação de dados, Python e R. -Formação superior completa em: Estatística, atuária ou matemática.

title: Chef de cozinha
description: Portuguese Translation Are Below  Tradução em Português Abaixo  Job Opening: Brazilian Chef (Singapore) We are seeking a  passionate and skilled Brazilian Chef  to join our team in Singapore, Restaurant name is Casa Brazilia. This is an exciting opportunity to bring the flavors, traditions, and spirit of Brazil to our growing restaurant brand.  Key Responsibilities  Menu Creation & Development  : Design authentic Brazilian dishes (churrasco, regional specialties, sides, and desserts) with modern presentation.  Catering & Events  : Lead menu planning and execution for private dining, corporate events, and large-scale catering.  Kitchen Management  : Supervise day-to-day operations, ensure quality standards, and train local staff.  Food Costing & Budgeting  : Develop accurate recipe costing, portion control, and inventory management to meet food cost targets.  Team Leadership  : Motivate, train, and guide the kitchen brigade to deliver consistent quality and strong teamwork.  Hygiene & Compliance  : Uphold Singapore food safety regulations and maintain the highest kitchen hygiene standards.  Innovation & Consistency  : Balance authentic Brazilian flavors with local preferences while ensuring consistency across all dishes.  Requirements  Proven experience as a Chef in Brazilian cuisine (steakhouse, churrascaria, or fine dining preferred).  Strong leadership, training, and people management skills.  Ability to manage food costs, supplier negotiations, and kitchen operations.  Passionate about introducing Brazilian culture and flavors to Singapore.  Adaptable, with good communication and organizational skills.  Compensation & Terms  Salary based on local Singapore market.  Flight and accommodation  to be arranged by candidate .  Full-time position based in Singapore.  About Us  We are a Brazilian steakhouse in Singapore, dedicated to creating unforgettable dining experiences with quality meats, authentic sides, and warm hospitality. Our vision is to share the joy of Brazilian food culture with every guest who walks through our doors.   Interested candidates: Please apply with your CV and portfolio of past work.  Vaga: Chef Brasileiro (Singapura) Estamos em busca de um  Chef Brasileiro apaixonado e talentoso  para se juntar à nossa equipe em Singapura. O restaurante se chama  Casa Brazilia . Esta é uma oportunidade empolgante de trazer os sabores, tradições e o espírito do Brasil para a nossa marca de restaurante em crescimento.  Principais Responsabilidades  Criação e Desenvolvimento de Cardápio  : Elaborar pratos autênticos da culinária brasileira (churrasco, especialidades regionais, acompanhamentos e sobremesas) com apresentação moderna.  Catering e Eventos  : Liderar o planejamento e a execução de menus para jantares privados, eventos corporativos e catering em grande escala.  Gestão da Cozinha  : Supervisionar as operações diárias, garantir padrões de qualidade e treinar a equipe local.  Custo e Orçamento  : Desenvolver fichas técnicas precisas, controle de porções e gestão de estoque para atingir metas de custo de alimentos.  Liderança de Equipe  : Motivar, treinar e orientar a brigada de cozinha para entregar qualidade consistente e trabalho em equipe.  Higiene e Conformidade  : Cumprir os regulamentos de segurança alimentar de Singapura e manter os mais altos padrões de higiene na cozinha.  Inovação e Consistência  : Equilibrar sabores autênticos brasileiros com preferências locais, garantindo consistência em todos os pratos.  Requisitos  Experiência comprovada como Chef em culinária brasileira (steakhouse, churrascaria ou alta gastronomia, de preferência).  Fortes habilidades de liderança, treinamento e gestão de pessoas.  Capacidade de gerenciar custos, negociar com fornecedores e administrar operações de cozinha.  Paixão por compartilhar a cultura e os sabores do Brasil em Singapura.  Perfil adaptável, com boas habilidades de comunicação e organização.  Remuneração e Condições  Salário de acordo com os padrões locais de chefs em Singapura.  Passagem aérea e acomodação  a cargo do candidato .  Posição em tempo integral, baseada em Singapura.  Sobre Nós  Somos uma churrascaria em Singapura dedicada a criar experiências gastronômicas inesquecíveis com carnes de qualidade, acompanhamentos autênticos e hospitalidade calorosa. Nossa visão é compartilhar a alegria da culinária brasileira com todos os nossos clientes.    Candidatos interessados  : Enviar currículo e portfólio de trabalhos anteriores.

title: Planner 25003639
